findings.issue: No test infrastructure at all: no test script, no runner dependency, no test files for ~812 lines of script logic
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest (Qwik's documented pairing) with unit tests for the exported pure functions in src/lib/data.ts and route-loader-level tests for filtering/pagination/sorting

findings.issue: fetchJson caches the promise for a failed fetch (network error or non-OK response returns null) permanently for the server's lifetime, so one transient API hiccup leaves that resource null until restart
findings.suggestion: Only cache successful responses, or add a test that a failed fetch is retried on the next request

findings.issue: Move dedup keyed `${method}:${moveName}` keeps only the first version_group_details entry; a move learned at two levels in the same version group/method silently loses a row, and level-up sorting assumes one level per move
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the candidate-row construction against a fixture with duplicate (method, move) entries and decide on min-level or multiple rows

findings.issue: Default game is 'last element' of a list built from an ascending sort of version groups — the 'highest order' invariant lives across two files and would break silently if the sort or filter changed
findings.suggestion: Test that the selected game equals max(order) over the Pokémon's games; or compute max explicitly at the selection site

findings.issue: speciesCardsFromRefs carries several invariants (alternate-form id>=10000 exclusion, byId dedup, hidden-flag OR-merge, dex-number sort) with no tests; a data-layer refactor could reintroduce Mega forms or lose hidden markers
findings.suggestion: Extract and unit-test the mapping with small synthetic refs (including id>=10000 and duplicate species)

findings.issue: Home filtering (case-insensitive substring vs humanized name), page clamping when page > totalPages, and the 48-per-page slice are untested; off-by-one or clamping removal would ship unnoticed
findings.suggestion: Unit-test parseHomeQuery + a pure filter/slice function (extract matches/visible computation from the component to make it testable)

findings.issue: compareRows' missing-value handling (nulls/'' always last, even on descending sort) is a deliberate rule with no test; a refactor to a generic comparator would flip it
findings.suggestion: Unit-test sorting with mixed null/number/string values in both directions

findings.issue: Filter state is written via window.history.replaceState inside onInput$/onChange$ handlers; reload, back/forward and deep-link behaviours are untested and bypass Qwik City's router
findings.suggestion: Consider qwik-city's useLocation/URL navigation or test deep links like /?type=fire&page=3&generation=generation-i against the rendered view

findings.issue: humanize/displayDex/latestEnglishFlavor/formatValue/idFromUrl are exported pure functions with edge cases (empty segments, whitespace collapsing, null IDs) and are the cheapest possible tests — none exist
findings.suggestion: Start the test suite here: a dozen lines of Vitest cover the naming/formatting rules the whole UI depends on

findings.issue: getHomeCatalog builds generationBySpecies and runs a 64-way-concurrent fetch over all species; ordering/assignment bugs (species in no generation, null sprite handling) have no regression net
findings.suggestion: Integration-test against a stubbed fetch with a handful of species, asserting generation mapping and null-sprite placeholders

summary: The app ships zero tests: no runner, no script, no test files, despite a data layer full of the highest-risk logic (URL state, filtering/pagination, dedup, sorting, request caching) and many exported pure functions that would be trivial to unit-test. Everything rests on the external acceptance suite, so any refactor after this PR — especially of speciesCardsFromRefs, the move-table construction, or fetchJson's permanently-cached failure path — has no guard at all. Adding Vitest tests for lib/data.ts and the pure filtering/sorting helpers would be the highest-leverage follow-up.
